notes.title: Update #61 (Achievements Patch)
notes.content:
Hey All! 

[b]This is just technical patch to adjust code to handle more achievements.[/b]

It seems the community likes the custom achievements idea, so I will be extending number of achievements to about 1K so everybody who want, can get their custom achievement. 

I hope that if you already got yours, you are having fun with it!

If you haven't yet requested for a personalized achievement and would like to get your custom achivo, you can use this forum thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/440730/discussions/0/133257636764514257/?ctp=6

If you like the idea please consider to leave a review, this is the only way I know what you think about the game and the custom achivo thing, 

and dont forget to check out our new game looking for greenlight:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=899418644

Thanks and Enjoy!

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update 51
notes.content:
Good Day All:

Here is a list of changes applied in this patch:

- COOP - minimap added to coop mode
- Single Player - several configuration options to survival modes like:

a. Wave Count - configures number of zombies in wave
b. Wave Number - configures number of waves
c. Infinite Waves  - no point commenting on this one
d. Cool Down Time - configures time between the waves 
e. Zombie factions - splits zombies into two factions 

- Choose from two characters - which will have different arsenal available

- Updated Tutorial

- Building mode fixes

Thank you for playing and Enjoy

notes.title: Update May 14th - New Game Modes & Locations
notes.content:
[h1] New Game Modes: [/h1]

- [b] Time Motion Mode [/b] - time depends on your velocity, if you move it runs smooth, but if you do not move it slows down

- [b] Moon Base mode [/b] - gravity is set to -0.1F so you can experience flying bodies and stuff

- [b] Time boxed mode [/b] - 60 seconds waves, if you kill all in 60 secs you win, if you don't you lose

- [b] Flood mode [/b]  - endless waves up to 100 enemies 

Classic modes:

- Campaign - Story based mode

- Survival - 4 waves challenge

[h1] 4 New Locations [/h1]

[h1] Bug fixes and UI updates [/h1]
